query: Наш эндпоинт /orders стал отвечать по 5 секунд после того как таблица выросла. Посмотри, в чём дело.
expected_behavior: Establishes the engine and version before giving any advice, rather than assuming PostgreSQL
Asks for (or obtains) an actual EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) plan instead of guessing from the SQL text
Names a root cause mechanism (non-sargable predicate, misordered composite index, stale statistics, disk spill) before proposing a fix
Proposes one change at a time and states how to verify it
